🇾🇪 BREAKING!!! Ansarallah has liberated the strategic Red Sea port city of Mukha.

Sanaa forces have taken control of Mukha following the collapse and withdrawal of Saudi-backed forces along Yemen’s western coast.

The capture comes after Ansarallah seized Hays, Camp Khalid, the Mukha junction and surrounding positions, triggering a rapid retreat toward Lahj and Aden.

Mukha is one of Yemen’s most strategically important ports, sitting immediately north of the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
